program: Wingless raw-input to representation to multi-step relational reasoning chain
question: Can Wingless discover value and operation representations from raw byte records, learn only single-step relational transitions, and then compose those learned transitions to solve unseen multi-step role programs without memorizing whole programs?
hypothesis: A nine-motif raw-byte representation learner will recover four value motifs and five operation motifs from single-step training records. A learned primitive transition model will then achieve at least 0.95 exact final-state accuracy on unseen three-, five-, and seven-step programs, including the untrained right-role transformation produced by swap-role conjugation, while an exact whole-program lookup trained on the same single-step records will achieve at most 0.25 held-out accuracy.

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% chain / 25% substrate falsification over the current prospective block

prior_evidence.observation: The learned raw representation recovered all eight value motifs and achieved 1.0 held-out compositional accuracy with 1.0 exact raw output accuracy while exact-pair lookup scored 0.0.

scope_statement: This is a bounded multi-step relational composition gate. Passing establishes composition of learned raw representations and learned primitive transitions under frozen synthetic controls; it does not establish open-domain reasoning.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

raw_benchmark.single_step_training: every one of the five operations on all sixteen ordered left/right value states, repeated forty times
raw_benchmark.record_encoding: raw deterministic noise, left value motif, noise, right value motif, noise, one operation motif, noise, observed output-left value motif, noise, observed output-right value motif
raw_benchmark.noise: deterministic LCG upper-bit bytes in range 192..255; no value, operation, or target information is encoded in noise
raw_benchmark.representation_labels: none supplied to motif selection; ordered record positions are used only after unsupervised motif discovery to identify observed input, operation, and output roles

representation_learner.candidate: every contiguous four-byte window within each training record
representation_learner.selection: top nine by occurrence count descending, then lexicographic raw key
representation_learner.expected_recurrent_motifs: four value motifs plus five operation motifs

transition_learner.state: for each learned operation representation and ordered learned value pair, a sixteen-way count distribution over observed output value pairs
transition_learner.prediction: argmax learned output pair for the current operation and current pair; ties choose lowest pair index
transition_learner.program_execution: feed each predicted pair into the next learned primitive transition until the unseen program ends
transition_learner.semantic_operation_code_visibility: none; prediction never calls the evaluator's logical operation implementation

whole_program_lookup_control.state: exact decoded operation-sequence plus input-pair -> output-pair counts
whole_program_lookup_control.training: the same single-step decoded records only
whole_program_lookup_control.heldout_behavior: multi-step program keys are unseen; ties choose lowest pair index
whole_program_lookup_control.purpose: tests whether held-out performance can be explained by memorizing exact whole programs

heldout_programs.conjugated_right: for every ordered input pair and each start in 0..3, evaluate swap_roles -> left_swap_start_k -> swap_roles; no right-role primitive exists in training
heldout_programs.long_program_generation: for every ordered input pair, four deterministic seeds per length generate frozen mixtures of swap_roles and left_swap operations

controls: All learner training is single-step; no multi-step program appears in training.
The representation learner receives raw bytes only and is not seeded with the nine evaluator motif identities.
The transition learner receives decoded observed training transitions only and never calls operation semantics during prediction.
The whole-program lookup receives the same decoded training records.
Heldout evaluation is read-only and every heldout program length is at least three.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, gradient optimizer, capacity growth, oracle correction, or post-result tuning is permitted.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
Exactly 3200 single-step raw records are generated from five operations x sixteen states x forty repeats.
The raw representation learner selects exactly nine motifs without evaluator motif seeding.
Decoded training records expose exactly four value representations and five operation representations.
Every learned operation/input-pair primitive transition has at least one training observation.
No heldout program sequence appears in training and all heldout programs contain at least three operations.
Prediction uses learned transition counts only; evaluator operation semantics are used for corpus generation and scoring only.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all nineteen frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and learned-transition composition materially exceeds whole-program lookup, but at least one 0.95 multi-step or raw-output threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but learned-transition composition does not materially outperform the whole-program lookup control or fails on the conjugated-right family.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the full frozen training/evaluation matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any representation, primitive coverage, semantic-isolation, program-isolation, deterministic-state, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific execution on parent, North Star, build, frozen-package, or representation-construction drift.
After output begins, complete all 192 heldout programs unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter motifs, operations, repetitions, heldout programs, transition state, controls, metrics, thresholds, or classification after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No benchmark, representation, transition learner, heldout program, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed under this experiment identifier.
